_readme: One entry per city_slug. intro: array of paragraphs (500 to 800 words total, real local copy from the data, no swapped-city boilerplate). faqs: 4 to 6 {q, a} written from the attribute data. Cities without an entry fall back to a short data-driven intro and attribute FAQs, and the build prints a warning for each so Gate 5 knows what is left to write.
